public_brief.objective: Meet an armed intruder with composure and still collect.
public_brief.tactic: Note the axe dryly and name the passage toll anyway.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Brakka comes through the door with the axe already up. Four pale figures in elaborate, old-fashioned clothes sit at a worn table with cards in hand and coins stacked before each of them. Behind them a carved mountain fills the north wall, rays of sunrise fanning out, and a long stone tub sits sunk in the floor beneath it. Every head turns to the axe.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Well. Whatever you were expecting to come running, my friend, it seems to have been us, and we are not running anywhere. You may lower that, or you may keep it raised; but a guest with an axe still pays her passage. Ten gold a head, for the dead. What will it be?
